meaning.en: The smallest score, below waza-ari: a landing on the side or further forward, on the upper back, on a buttock or the neck, or a hold-down of five to nine seconds. Removed from international judo in 2017 and brought back for the current Olympic cycle. Yuko are counted but never add up to a waza-ari; they separate contestants otherwise level, and the first one wins golden score.
